subject: Novaforge discovery: alignment and pilot scope confirmation
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Moore <dana.moore@novaforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Novaforge discovery: alignment and pilot scope confirmation

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we have alignment and clear next steps before we draft the SOW:

Pain points you shared:
- Search/QA accuracy on user-submitted technical tickets is low (~40% correct routing).
- High latency and cost when running current models for summarization across long threads.
- Auditing and retention requirements for regulated support tickets (retention 7 years, exportable audit logs).

Goals for a 6-week pilot (what I captured):
1) Improve routing preciseness to >= 70% on a curated pilot ticket sample.
2) Reduce average token cost per-ticket generation by 30% versus current production baseline.
3) Provide an auditable pipeline for prompt/eval results and exportable logs for 90% of pilot traffic.

Proposed pilot scope (high level):
- Data: 5k anonymized support tickets (we'll share the uploader script + sample template).
- Model & infra: Redwood hosted inference using a quantized open model + fallback to a smaller variant for cost control.
- Prompts & evals: 25 labeled examples for routing + prompt set of 100 prompts for quality regression checks.
- Owners: Novaforge Data Lead (you) + Redwood PM (Marissa) + Solutions Eng (Ben).
- Success metrics & cadence: weekly sync, baseline comparison report at weeks 3 and 6.

Access/setup asks we outlined on the call:
- Upload access for the anonymized ticket CSV (S3 or Drive link).
- A service account for limited-priv API keys and a procurement contact for the SOW.

Attachments: I attached a short template (novaforge_mvp_requirements.xlsx) and a first-pass SOW stub (redwood_poc_sow_draft.pdf).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the three pilot goals above or suggest edits (reply-all).
2) If goals look good, Marissa will draft the SOW and Ben will request temporary access for ingestion.
3) Dana to share preferred upload mechanism + a procurement contact (email).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to iron out the success metric definitions quickly.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Dana Moore <dana.moore@novaforge.ai>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novaforge.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novaforge discovery: alignment and pilot scope confirmation

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Routing target: we can agree to 70% on the pilot labeled set, but commercial teams want to see improvement on the broader live sample at pilot end. Can you include a plan for holdout validation?
2) Cost reduction: the 30% looks reasonable as a target if you include caching/continuous batching in the runbook. Please call out any potential accuracy regressions with quantization.
3) Audit logs: we need exports in a format our compliance team can ingest (CSV or JSONL) with per-request metadata (timestamp, model id, prompt hash).

Procurement: looping in procurement for SOW/PO — procurement@novaforge.ai will handle the contract.

Upload: we can share the anonymized S3 location. I'll send credentials once we sign the NDA addendum (we have a standard template).

Confirming I'll share the S3 path and the procurement contact in a follow-up tomorrow. Otherwise the proposed owners look good.

Thanks,
Dana Moore
Head of Data Science | Novaforge
[d] dana.moore@novaforge.ai

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novaforge discovery: alignment and pilot scope confirmation

Eve / Ben —

Thanks — Dana's asks are straightforward. Quick ops notes and owners from my side: 

- Holdout validation: we'll reserve a 20% holdout split and run evaluation at week 6. Ben, can you add a simple evaluation job to run the holdout set daily once data lands? Output should include precision/recall and confusion matrix export.
- Quantization risks: I'll call out expected delta in the SOW and include threshold gates — if routing accuracy drops >5% versus float baseline we'll revert to a higher-precision variant.
- Audit logs: Ben, we'll need to capture request_id, timestamp, model_variant, prompt_hash, response_score; JSONL output written to a secured bucket.

Timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (sign & access): NDA addendum + SOW sign, S3 access shared.
- Week 1: Data ingest + mapping, smoke tests.
- Week 2–4: Iteration on prompts and model tuning, weekly sync.
- Week 5: Holdout evaluation & final tuning.
- Week 6: Final report and decision point.

Ben, can you confirm you have capacity to start ingestion the week of Mar 9? I'll assemble the SOW this afternoon and drop a link to the draft.

Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Dana —

Great, thanks for the quick reply and for looping in procurement. Notes and confirmed next steps below: 

1) We will include a holdout validation plan (20% holdout) in the SOW and automated daily holdout runs once ingestion is complete.
2) Marissa will add quantization rollback gates and monitor accuracy deltas; threshold is +5% delta revert.
3) Ben will publish audit logs as JSONL with the fields you specified.

Please send the S3 path and procurement contact; once procurement confirms the PO process we'll schedule the Week 0 kickoff (20–30 minute call) and begin ingestion.

I will attach the SOW draft link here when it's ready and propose a kickoff window next Wednesday or Thursday.

Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Cheers,
